mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, eroding corporate profit expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 300 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 5.0%, the market interprets aggressive monetary policy to combat economic deterioration, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 300 and FEDFUNDS < 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary demand environment, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals further deterioration in the real estate sector and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during recessionary demand environments when HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, eroding corporate revenue growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300 and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, the market perceives a simultaneous collapse in both the housing sector and manufacturing, signaling a deepening economic contraction and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1300 and INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime, a month-over-month increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals the Federal Reserve's potential for monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during high-inflation regimes when CPIAUCSL increases.
